findings.description: The bundle is built with locale=chain[0], which is the normalised tag. A caller passing 'pt_br' or 'PT-br' gets a bundle whose locale is 'pt-BR'. Previously the locale was returned as given. Callers that key bundles or reports by the requested string (e.g. missing_report) can now see a different key than the one they passed.
findings.suggestion: Keep the requested locale in Bundle.locale, and use the normalised chain only for lookups. Or document and test the change.
findings.title: Bundle.locale is now the normalised locale, not the one requested

findings.description: The previous code made one catalog.get_many call for all keys. The new code calls catalog.exists and catalog.get for every key in every candidate locale, so a page with N keys and a chain of length L makes up to 2*N*L catalog calls. If the catalog is backed by a DB or file, this becomes an N+1 pattern. The two calls per hit are also not atomic.
findings.suggestion: Fetch with get_many per locale in the chain for the keys still unresolved, and shrink the unresolved set after each locale.
findings.title: Per-key exists/get calls replace the single batched get_many lookup
